Bill.BriefDescription: Preventing businesses from taking multiple tax credits on the same employment positions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preventing businesses from taking multiple taxcredits on the same employment positions; and amending RCW 82.62.090.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 82.62.090 and 2000 c 106 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (((1))) A person is not eligible to receive a credit under thischapter if the person is receiving credit for the same position underRCW 82.04.44525 or 82.04.4456. (((2) This section expires December 31, 2003.))
